annotations.annotation: Profiler pod SF01B has been docked in preparation for the 2024 recovery cruise. No further profiles will be run until the new profiler is in place.

Following several winch issues early in the 2023 deployment, the levelwind continues to function incorrectly. However, after a brief period of stationary sampling and testing, the profiler is now able to complete partial cycles from 179 to 144 meters under automated control, with a 1 hour wait at each depth. Sensor sampling intervals have been modified accordingly.
